answer: A sponsor carries 28% of any slash its member incurs, so vouching is a financial position rather than a courtesy. Because the hollow liability is published in the pearl ledger at admission, the shale audit exposes the shared exposure and internal sponsorship is self-defeating. A farm must hence place its own capital behind each duplicate self it sponsors, which is the same as paying the bond twice for each key it runs. That is 4 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
